title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Seriously Studying and Implementing the Decision of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress on Amending the Criminal Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China
full_text_en:
Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Earnestly Studying and Implementing the Decision of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress on Amending the Criminal Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China

Fa [2018] No. 294

High People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; and the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

On October 26, 2018, the Sixth Session of the Standing Committee of the 13th National People's Congress deliberated and adopted the Decision of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress on Amending the Criminal Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China (hereinafter referred to as the "Decision on Amendment"). For the purpose of correctly implementing the amended Criminal Procedure Law, the relevant matters are hereby notified as follows:

1. Deeply Understand the Significant Significance of the Amendment of the Criminal Procedure Law

The Criminal Procedure Law is the basic law regulating criminal procedure activities and an important basis for the people's courts to adjudicate criminal cases. This amendment to the Criminal Procedure Law improves the connection between supervision and criminal procedure, establishes the criminal trial in absentia system, and elevates the pilot reform results of leniency for admitting guilt and accepting punishment and the fast-track sentencing procedure into legal provisions. It is of great significance for implementing the spirit of the 19th National Congress of the Communist Party of China, deepening the reform of the state supervision system, intensifying efforts to combat corruption and recover stolen assets and pursue fugitives, and deepening the reform of criminal procedure. This is another important reform and improvement of the criminal procedure system with Chinese characteristics, following the amendments to the Criminal Procedure Law in 1996 and 2012. People's courts at all levels must attach great importance to the study, publicity, and implementation of the Decision on Amendment, ensure the correct and uniform implementation of the law through high-quality and efficient trial activities, and ensure the full realization of the purposes and objectives of the legal amendment.

2. Resolutely Implement the Amended Criminal Procedure Law

(1) Properly Handle the Connection between Supervision and Criminal Procedure. The amended Criminal Procedure Law adjusts the investigative functions of the people's procuratorates and provides connection provisions for the procedural mechanisms concerning the stage where a supervisory authority transfers a case to the people's procuratorate for review and prosecution after the completion of its investigation. The content of the legal amendment must be accurately understood, relevant cases must be tried in accordance with the law, and the smooth progress of the reform of the state supervision system must be ensured. In accordance with the provisions of the amended Criminal Procedure Law and Article 33 of the Supervision Law, and based on the requirements and standards for evidence in criminal trials, the evidentiary materials collected by the supervisory authority, including physical evidence, documentary evidence, witness testimony, confessions and defenses of the person under investigation, audio-visual materials, and electronic data, shall be examined and determined.

(2) Carefully Handle Criminal Cases of Trial in Absentia. Accurately grasp the scope of application of criminal trial in absentia, properly try criminal cases that meet the conditions for trial in absentia, and promote the international pursuit of fugitives in anti-corruption work. In accordance with the provisions of the amended Criminal Procedure Law, serve the summons and a copy of the procuratorial authority's bill of indictment on the defendant through judicial assistance provided for in international treaties or through diplomatic channels, or by other means permitted by the law of the defendant's location, to ensure the defendant's right to be informed. In cases tried in absentia by the people's court, attention must be paid to protecting the defendant's litigation rights, including the right to defense and the right to appeal of the defendant and the defendant's near relatives. If a case has been suspended or the defendant has died, and it meets the provisions of Articles 296 and 297 of the amended Criminal Procedure Law, a trial in absentia may be conducted. For the first criminal trial in absentia case within the jurisdiction, a prompt report must be made level by level to the Supreme People's Court.

(3) Focus on Protecting the Defendant's Litigation Rights. If the defendant has not entrusted a defense counsel and the legal aid institution has not assigned a lawyer to provide defense, promptly inform the defendant of the right to meet with a duty lawyer and facilitate the defendant's meeting with a duty lawyer, so as to truly achieve full coverage of criminal defense or legal assistance. Strictly in accordance with the provisions of the amended Criminal Procedure Law, persons who have been expelled from public office and those whose lawyer or notary practice certificates have been revoked may not serve as defense counsel unless they are the guardians or near relatives of the defendant.

(4) Actively Apply the Fast-Track Sentencing Procedure and the System of Leniency for Admitting Guilt and Accepting Punishment. People's courts that were previously included in the pilot reform shall continue to optimize their working methods; those not included in the pilot reform shall begin implementation immediately. Accurately grasp the conditions for applying the fast-track sentencing procedure and the system of leniency for admitting guilt and accepting punishment, adhere to the principle of speeding up without lowering standards and simplifying without diminishing rights, improve the evidence system, perfect the procedures for informing litigation rights, and promote the dual improvement of justice and efficiency.

(5) Correctly Cite the Law and Apply Relevant Provisions. For judgments and rulings made after October 26, 2018, the provisions of the amended Criminal Procedure Law shall apply, and the article numbers and contents of the amended Criminal Procedure Law shall be cited (the full text of the amended Criminal Procedure Law has been published on Xinhuanet by authorization of Xinhua News Agency). The Supreme People's Court will promptly revise the Interpretation on the Application of the Criminal Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China to ensure the correct and uniform implementation of the amended Criminal Procedure Law. Prior to the issuance of the new judicial interpretation, if the Criminal Procedure Law provisions on which previous judicial interpretations and normative documents were based have not been substantially amended, those provisions may continue to apply or be implemented by reference.

3. Do a Good Job in Study, Training, and Publicity

People's courts at all levels shall make the study of the Decision on Amendment a key task for the current and upcoming period, adopt various forms, and within about half a year, train all criminal trial personnel. Study the new provisions, research new practices, grasp the new spirit, and thoroughly understand the legislative intent, specific meaning, and conditions for application of the Decision on Amendment. In light of local actual conditions, give full play to the advantages of trial work, cooperate with relevant departments, and carry out targeted publicity on the amended Criminal Procedure Law.

During the process of studying, publicizing, and implementing the amended Criminal Procedure Law, people's courts at all levels shall strengthen investigation and research on new problems and new situations encountered, and pay attention to collecting and timely reporting major and difficult issues concerning the understanding and application of the law encountered. They shall support and cooperate with the Supreme People's Court in revising the Interpretation on the Application of the Criminal Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China.

November 7, 2018
